topic: How would the 0.25 dB passband loss affect link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends?
consensus_response: The 0.25 dB passband loss reduces link margin, degrading signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and increasing susceptibility to interference. Non-linear effects like intermodulation distortion and phase noise further compromise system performance. Mitigation strategies include optimizing receiver chains, employing antenna diversity, and improving oscillator stability to maintain optimal performance.
reference_context: Link budget margins are crucial for reliable satellite communication, with passband loss and phase noise affecting signal quality and availability.
